farm_state_snapshot_note: farm_state.sqlite is a live, growing DB; this dataset is a timestamped snapshot, not reproducible-forever. Content-address via the per-file sha256 map and this manifest's own sha256 (dataset_id).

query_text.ea_metrics.csv: SELECT work_item_id, ea_id, symbol, phase, verdict, net_profit, profit_factor, trades, drawdown_money, drawdown_pct, sharpe FROM ea_metrics ORDER BY work_item_id
query_text.gate_outcomes.csv: SELECT id, ea_id, symbol, phase, verdict, verdict_taxonomy, verdict_reason, setfile_path, data_window_start, data_window_end, created_at FROM work_items_clean ORDER BY created_at, id
query_text.holds.csv: SELECT work_item_id, hold_code, reason, active FROM work_item_holds ORDER BY work_item_id
query_text.parameter_sensitivity.csv: SELECT work_item_id, ea_id, symbol, phase, detail_json FROM ea_metrics ORDER BY work_item_id
query_text.sources.csv: SELECT id, source_type, lane, status, uri, title FROM sources ORDER BY id
